name: Dobro pozhalovat' v Omsk
source:
The protagonist goes to the city of Omsk to complete the task assigned to him by the kidnappers of his sister Nadya. If he completes the task, Nadya will be free. But he does not even suspect what is really happening in Omsk and what events he will have to participate in.

[Translated From [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/10-1-0-331]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
主角前往鄂木斯克，完成绑架妹妹娜佳的绑匪交给他的任务。只要完成任务，娜佳就能获得自由。但他根本没有意识到鄂木斯克正在发生什么，也不知道自己将被迫参与哪些事件。

[译自 [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/10-1-0-331]Anivisual[/url]]
